name: 37659 · Jonesborough, TN
findings: ZIP 37659 (Jonesborough) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37659 (Jonesborough) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37659 (Jonesborough) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
